{{Top|leg}}
'''Yurfloo''' was a poison created by the [[Th'iruckai]]. [[Hurn Jak]], a [[Teruk]] of a Th'iruckai clan was the only individual with the antidote. Consequently, when off-world [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] were poisoned with it, they were forced to trade with Jak in order to survive.
